# openwrt_dhcp_host (Resource)

A static DHCP lease (`config host`).

Manages a `host` section in `/etc/config/dhcp`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwrt_dhcp_host" "nas" {
  section = "nas"
  name    = "nas"
  mac     = ["aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"]
  ip      = "192.168.1.10"
  dns     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `broadcast` (Boolean) Force broadcast replies. (UCI option `broadcast`.)
- `dns` (Boolean) Add a DNS entry for the host. (UCI option `dns`.)
- `duid` (List of String) DHCPv6 DUIDs. (UCI option `duid`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `hostid` (String) IPv6 host id (hex). (UCI option `hostid`.)
- `instance` (String) dnsmasq instance. (UCI option `instance`.)
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address, or `ignore`. (UCI option `ip`.)
- `leasetime` (String) Lease time override. (UCI option `leasetime`.)
- `mac` (List of String) MAC addresses. (UCI option `mac`.)
- `name` (String) Hostname. (UCI option `name`.)
- `tag` (List of String) Tags to set. (UCI option `tag`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import openwrt_dhcp_host.nas nas
```
